name: pbt-extension
description: Run property-based and threat-model tests for Plinth smart contracts, and explore results, transaction graphs, and script coverage.

pbt-extension.executionMode.description: Select the mode for executing commands with PBT.

walkthroughs.title: PBT Extension Walkthrough
walkthroughs.description: A walkthrough for getting started with PBT.

steps.title: View Documentation
steps.description:
Documentation can be found on the README in the GitHub repository. It contains detailed information about the extension's features, configuration options, and usage instructions.
 You can also find the documentation in the **Extensions** view in the Side Bar, find **PBT**, and navigate to the extension page.
[Open the PBT repository](https://github.com/input-output-hk/sc-testing-tools-vs-extension)

media.altText: An editor window with an arrow pointing to a documentation page

steps.title: Set Up Your Environment
steps.description:
PBT runs your test suites using either Docker or Nix. you **MUST HAVE** one of them installed and working in order for the extension to run.
**Docker**: install Docker Desktop or Docker Engine and make sure it is actually running. 
**Nix**: install Nix. 
Choose which one PBT uses with the `pbt-extension.executionMode` setting, then open the **Test Run Configuration** view to confirm your choice is detected.
[Choose your execution mode](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22pbt-extension.executionMode%22%5D)

media.altText: The VS Code Settings editor showing the PBT execution mode set to docker

steps.title: Install the Backend Tool
steps.description:
This extension is the user interface. Test suites are built and executed by the PBT backend tool, which has to be available on your machine before the extension can run anything.
PBT invokes the backend through whichever execution mode you selected in the previous step, so finish that step first.
The backend tool lives in its own repository, and its README covers how to install it.
[Open the backend tool repository](https://github.com/input-output-hk/sc-testing-tools)
Once the backend is in place, you are all set to start using the extension.

media.altText: An editor window with an arrow pointing to the backend tool running inside a container

steps.title: Get Help and Report Issues
steps.description:
If something is not working as expected, please open an issue on our repository as a support request and we will take a look.
It helps us a lot if you include your operating system, whether you are running in **Docker** or **Nix** mode, and the exact error message PBT showed you.
[Open a support request](https://github.com/input-output-hk/sc-testing-tools-vs-extension/issues/new)

media.altText: An error in the extension becoming an issue on the repository

steps.title: Contribute to PBT
steps.description:
PBT is open source under the Apache 2.0 licence, and contributions are welcome.
Community contributions are currently managed through GitHub Issues, so you can help by reporting bugs, suggesting improvements, or telling us where the documentation falls short. The Cardano High Assurance team reviews and triages everything that comes in.
Before opening a new issue, please check whether an existing one already covers it.
[Read the contributing guide](https://github.com/input-output-hk/sc-testing-tools-vs-extension/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

media.altText: Local changes opened as a pull request and merged into the project
